scenarios.criterion: A first-time user is explicitly told how to dump context and how to signal completion.
scenarios.observableOutcome: The first response explains Context Dump and names `dump complete` or `덤프 끝`.

scenarios.criterion: No analysis, design, or generation occurs before the Dump Complete Signal.
scenarios.observableOutcome: An open Context Dump receives only a receipt and an invitation to continue or complete it.

scenarios.criterion: Clarification asks one decision at a time and includes a recommended answer.
scenarios.observableOutcome: Each clarification turn has one decision question and a recommendation.

scenarios.criterion: Generation waits for an approved Alignment Gate containing observable Acceptance Criteria.
scenarios.observableOutcome: The Alignment Gate contains an observable Acceptance Criterion and explicitly asks for approval before delivery.

scenarios.criterion: Delivery separates the English Final Prompt, Korean Review Translation, and Run Instructions and requires a Fresh Run.
scenarios.observableOutcome: Delivery has the three labelled sections in order and Run Instructions require a Fresh Run.

scenarios.criterion: The happy-path Acceptance Scenario is demonstrably runnable through the canonical skill.
scenarios.observableOutcome: The canonical skill and observed happy-path transcript pass their deterministic contract checks.
